summary: Warehouse-backed commercial car park; homes 27 m+ away across a lane.
reasons: Backs onto warehouses and liquor store
Open, drive-in lot with painted bays

drivers.seclusion: Warehouses on the west and east; apartments 27 m and 43 m away on the far side of the southern street, offices to the north.
drivers.access_and_room: Open entrances from the street; aisle and bays fit a van, though the lot is mostly full of cars.
drivers.traffic: Quiet inside the lot; busy road along the north edge and a hotel nearby.
drivers.convention: Dense with parked cars; no campervans or tents seen.

flags: Low-lying: min 3.6 m, Brisbane River 188 m away
Likely tenant or customer parking; signs and cameras not visible
Busy road and hotel noise at the north end
Nearby street signs: taxi zone and no-parking times, not on the lot
sun_shade: Open to sun; a few small trees shade the south edge in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Whether the lot is private or time-limited

best_section.where: West-side bays of the car park, along the old warehouse wall off the southern street
